sources.snippet: A model an agency or photographer wants to credit Frequently asked questions How do I find a model by a photo? Upload a clear, front-facing photo. Our visual search reads the face and compares it against every model in the GetModel directory, then returns the closest match plus similar-looking models — each linking to a full profile.
